{{Quote|Well, today I've decided to teach you a lesson in the power of ''commerce''! When there's war, there's money. But when there's ''no'' war, I'll ''make'' one...|[[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]]|<ref name="The Runaway Ride" />}}
After losing his profit due to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Liberation of Nothoiin|liberation]] of [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]], [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]] staged an '''ambush''' of the [[Goldskin Parade]], in order to create more war, and thus more profit.
